Case No. 1855 29012023

Date: N/A.

Approximate Time: N/A.

Location: Rancagua and Santiago.

Witnesses: R. A. M. F., 71 years old.

Images: The user only provided their testimony.

Description: At 21:15 hours on January 29, 2023, the SEFAA (National Commission for Aerospatial Phenomena) received, through its web platform, a report submitted by the informant describing frequent sightings of numerous lights that he attributed to an anomalous origin.

The user described the reported light as similar to a star, moving in an irregular pattern.

As it did not indicate size, but it was visible for more than a minute and appeared from the east. He did not say in which direction it stopped being seen, but there were more than three witnesses.

"For over 2 months now, I have observed, especially at night, but
Also, before twilight, small and numerous lights (up to 19 simultaneously) that move in different ways, circles, zigzag, straight line, sometimes at great speed and over long distances. I have seen them
in the sky over Rancagua and over Santiago even in the company of my daughters,

"My nephews and grandchildren. It seems very strange to me that being visible to the naked eye (although I believe not so easily) there are no comments about it," he wrote in his report, along with which he did not include audiovisual files.

He did not indicate a specific date or location for an observation, but rather stated that he has observed phenomena that he considers anomalous in the sky over Rancagua and Santiago, so it was not possible to georeference their location.

At 10:07 a.m. on Monday, January 30, 2023, SEFAA sent an email

An electronic message was sent to the witness to explain that the unit studies particular events and that it needs evidence. He was asked if he had a particular event to report, with photographs and/or recordings to support it.

At 10:46 a.m. on the same day, the user responded via email, thanking "the promptness and seriousness of the response to my report," stating that his "intention is not to guarantee an investigation to answer my questions. Rather, just to alert of what I have been able to verify late at night."

"It has been almost two months and I am surprised that I have not seen other reactions until today" and that it has no possibility "of taking and sending evidence" as it does not have a camera that can film what it says it observed.

Finally, he regretted not being able to provide evidence and reiterated his agreement and gratitude "for the promptness and seriousness with which my report was received."

Conclusion: In accordance with point 2d of the Technical Instruction on Procedures, Investigation Timelines, Report Reception and Processing.
The Executive and Reports Archive SEFAA (Only cases reporting original images, audios, or videos will be investigated), proceeded to close the case and classify it as "Narrative".
